title: GitHub Replica
overview: A GitHub-style application for repository discovery and developer profiles. React renders personal and suggested repositories while Express handlers manage repository and user documents.
features: MongoDB repository ownership and issue relationships
Repository create, update, visibility, and delete handlers
Client-side repository name filtering and account login
role: I connected the React repository interface to Express handlers and MongoDB records, including repository lists, profile views, and account flows.
challenges: Presenting related repository, owner, and issue records while keeping client search state aligned with fetched data.
impact: I built a React repository explorer backed by Express routes, MongoDB documents, repository ownership queries, and client-side name filtering.

title: Zoom Clone
overview: A real-time video conferencing application with room-based communication and live peer connectivity.
role: I built the meeting UI, signaling logic, room lifecycle, client-state handling, and deployment configuration.
challenges: Handled real-time connection state, peer negotiation, and graceful updates when users join or leave sessions.
impact: I connected WebRTC peer negotiation to Socket.io room signaling and built meeting controls around participant and media state.

title: Banking App SaaS
overview: A lending application with separate borrower, lender, and admin interfaces. React dashboards connect loan requests, review decisions, repayment records, and reporting to an Express API.

Express loan creation and approve/reject endpoints
Sequelize models for users, loans, and related financial records
role: I connected role-oriented React screens to Express endpoints, relational loan models, and dashboard data views.
challenges: Keeping loan lifecycle states and role-specific interfaces aligned with API responses and relational records.
impact: I connected React dashboards to Express loan endpoints and Sequelize models, with pending, approved, and rejected loan states.
